bullets_en: Most Americans blame Trump for high prices as midterms approach.
MP Mallu Ravi rejects ‘Reddy favouritism’ charge.
Keralam government to formulate draft Bill for setting up Tribal University in Wayanad.
Dipke Demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Resignation, Warns of Protests.
bullets_ur: Ameerki logon ka yeh kehna hai ke Trump qeematein barhane ka zimmedar hai jabke intikhabat qareeb hai.
MP Mallu Ravi ne "Reddy ke liye pasandgi" ka ilzam khara kar diya.
Keralam hukumat Wayanad mein Tribal University banane ke liye draft Bill tayaar kar rahi hai.
Dipke CEC Gyanesh Kumar ki istifa talab kar rahe hain, ehtijaj ka khatra dene laga hai.
